project_description: Harden only Go-LIP's highest-ROI long-lived resource ownership seams using a small Cordis-v4-inspired acquire-plus-release discipline: make process-owned acquisition register cleanup before the resource escapes, remove closer-slice propagation from selected ProcessServices builders, and encapsulate the existing cancel+join pattern for generation-owned background loops. Preserve ResourceLedger, immutable generations, request pinning, backend plugin ABI, routing/streaming/billing semantics, and all public APIs; add no DI container, service locator, reactive dependency graph, effect system, or whole-repo refactor.
